pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/quality_gate.rs:95 ships a default Reject rule on the bare substring 'has no' (also matches 'has now'/'has not'), applied at src-tauri/src/engine/dispatch.rs:992 to every agent ManualReview, so legitimate human-decision reviews are silently discarded by a detector whose precision was never measured and whose rejections reach no audit record (the policy-off drop at :863 does)

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/quality_gate.rs:95 'has no' and :80 'api_key' substring rules default to Reject (:109) via plain contains (:130); no precision measurement against the review population exists, and a rejected review is logged only to the execution log (src-tauri/src/engine/dispatch.rs:992) with no counted audit row, so neither precision nor recall can ever be computed
src-tauri/src/engine/dispatch.rs:904 Reject returns before mem_repo::create, so the label's severity is the construction's severity (Tag/Warn fall through to store)

src-tauri/db/src/quality_gate.rs:146 an unparseable saved config is replaced by the defaults with only a warn, so an operator's narrowed rule set silently reverts to the shipped Reject rules - a broken instrument input read as a valid policy

pairs.registryProposal: false-positive-economics' 'nobody was entitled to the artifact' carve-out (machine-generated candidates) should say what happens when the refused machine candidate IS a request for a human decision: dropping it removes the human from the loop, so a false positive costs a missed decision, not a wasted generation.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_triage/findings/verify.ts:104 a sensor that did not probe this sweep yields 'pending' with reason sensor_not_probed, never 'cleared' - absence in the instrument is not read as compliance
src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_triage/findings/verify.ts:168 the verify state is written only after the item already shipped; no stage boundary is gated on it

pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson for unmeasurable-criteria / measurement-honesty: verify.ts:95-112 makes the probed-origins set a REQUIRED argument so no call site can forget to distinguish 'signal absent' from 'sensor skipped' - the derivation lives in the signature, not in a null-check each caller must remember.
